goal: Speed up UTXO cache lookups and rehashing during IBD, reindexing, and snapshot loading
Avoid recomputing hash codes repeatedly under GCC standard library at the cost of slight node memory
agreement: Concept support citing benchmark performance gains over the memory tradeoff (optout21)

categories.name: validation
why: P3 because speedup is modest and reasonably deferrable
Gains roughly 2% in reindexing and up to 11% in snapshot loading on GCC
Adds slight memory overhead to nodes in the UTXO cache
